what_to_detect: A saddle activation (keyword line, AlterAttribute) whose cost taps other creatures with enough total power and whose effect makes the Mount saddled: the Mount gains the saddled designation.
near_miss: A saddle ability that resolves without the Mount becoming saddled.

what_to_detect: A record of a permanent carrying the saddled designation (gen-3 designations), present only in the turn it became saddled.
near_miss: The same permanent in a later turn without the designation.
